reviewer: Claude source, predicate and witness review
scope: robolab RubiksCubeAndBananaTask at the pinned revision; seed 0 witness only. Semantic projection of the official predicate, not physical qualification of other seeds or scenes.
task_language: Put the cube and the banana in the bowl

predicate_and_helpers.basis: Read RubiksCubeAndBananaTerminations.success with logical all, object_in_container and gripper_detached.

reset_and_randomization.basis: Scene rubiks_cube_banana_bowl.usda with cube, banana, bowl and table.

assets_and_frames.basis: Container test in the bowl's local frame; each object's centroid tested separately.

success_timing.basis: Evaluated every control step; RoboLab freezes the episode at success and the ORA session latches it.

public_observability.basis: Cube, banana and bowl are visible in the over-shoulder and wrist cameras.

success_witness.basis: Witness: banana then cube dropped into the bowl with the robot held away gives the success termination on seed 0.

counterexamples.basis: Witness: banana alone in the bowl and the reset state give false.

no_expert_strategy.basis: Clauses state end conditions only; no approach, grasp, route or motion advice.

privacy.basis: No coordinates, thresholds, fixture or object identifiers, joint values or predicate names enter the public text; numeric limits stay in this private record.

conditions.interpretation: Both objects inside the bowl, each touching it.
Contact force bar and container box slack withheld.
conditions.omission_reason: Numeric limits stay off-policy; object order is free.

public_clauses: Both the cube and the banana must end up inside the bowl, each touching it.
Let go of each of them: the task is not complete while the gripper still touches either one.

counterexamples.case: Only the banana in the bowl: false.

limitations: Witness covers seed 0 only and uses direct state edits or scripted moves, never a policy rollout; source-derived negative cases marked as such were not executed.
